_comment: Competitor rates scraped from Booking.com property pages (lowest total price incl. taxes & fees, SGD, 2 adults, 1 night). display_rate is Booking's advertised base price; est_incl_taxes and all by_category values are TAX-AND-FEE INCLUSIVE (base + the '+S$ X taxes and charges' line; used as-is where Booking states 'includes taxes and charges'; x1.19 fallback only where no tax line is shown). units_left_total sums remaining inventory across all room types (incl. dorm capsules for Kinn Habitat; dorm RATES excluded - private rooms only). by_category maps each competitor's room types onto Heritage Collection categories (Single / Studio / Loft / Suite): rooms named Single/Solo -> Single, Loft/Duplex -> Loft, Suite/Family/Apartment -> Suite, and Studio plus generic standard/superior/deluxe double/twin/queen/king rooms -> Studio. Categories a competitor does not offer, or that are sold out for that date, are omitted rather than substituted. Coverage: every day from 2026-08-05 to 2026-08-18 (near-term daily window), the Monday of each remaining week to 12 weeks out, plus high-demand event dates (26 Sep, 3/7/10 Oct); dates from prior runs that were not re-scraped are retained.
